docker-base.note: the Docker image base; package licences under /usr/share/doc/*/copyright in the image

docker-s6-overlay.note: process supervisor in the Docker image

docker-node.note: Node.js runtime in the Docker image; its bundled libraries are listed in the LICENSE file it ships

sections.title: Build tools (never shipped)
sections.text: `electron-builder` (MIT) is a development dependency of `apps/desktop` that turns the staged app into installers (P20-38); nothing of it is copied into the packaged app (`apps/desktop/scripts/stage-app.mjs` stages only production packages and refuses any licence that is not on the allow-list). Its tree contains packages under licences outside our allow-list; the licence guard gates production dependencies only, so they are recorded here while the owner's ruling on build-only licences is pending (D-16.715). Other CI-only tools (hadolint, GPL-3.0; actionlint, MIT) run in CI and are never shipped.
